timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra, with their master Tocasia, explore the sacred cave of Koilos; Urza falls behind in the Hall of Tagsin and finds the Mightstone.
timeline.quote: Urza fell behind in the Hall of Tagsin, where he discovered the remarkable Mightstone.
